mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, it is a clear 81 degrees at Verona Community Park under a full moon, with no visible ISS passes to report. Tonight, we will see a low of 69 degrees, and you do not need to worry about rain as none is predicted.

The city has two important updates. Residents interested in the tri-shaw program should note that a waiver is required, which may need a witness signature or an in-person visit to the senior center. Additionally, the City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for students, with voting for the top designs open through August 7.

Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow, trivia fans have plenty of options with events at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee, followed by more trivia and live music throughout the week at venues like Paddy Mac's and The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, on July 26, an officer stopped a vehicle for traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway, resulting in the driver being arrested for O W I.

Today is the perfect day to enjoy the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. The shop is currently closed, but they will open their doors at 10 AM tomorrow, when the flavor of the day will be Georgia Peach.
